messages:
anna_se: Heads-up: Orin Labs POC seeing inconsistent TTFT during ramp. Demo tomorrow; they reported 300ms baseline then spikes to 700-900ms and occasional 429s. Can we triage?
ryan_oncall: Ping. Do we have sample req_ids and model? Also which region?
anna_se: reqs: orin-44f, orin-44g. Model: open-gpt-v2. Region: eu-central. Seq lengths ~80-400, mix of short system prepends + long continuation. They turned on prefill=true to speed cold starts.
emma_support: On it. Quick scan shows kv_cache_status=miss for both reqs and batching.window_ms jumped to ~110ms during the spike window. Log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-21T09:12:03Z] req=orin-44f model=open-gpt-v2 seq=320 batch_id=912 kv_cache=MISS first_token_ms=812
[2026-03-21T09:12:03Z] req=orin-44f 429 reason=tenant_rate_limit tenant=orin
```
liu_eng: Two likely contributors: 1) their usage pattern invalidates cache (unique system messages per request) -> high decode cost, 2) batching window expansion due to queueing -> higher TTFT. Also see small burst of in-flight >16 for that pool.
priya_security: Any workarounds touching cache: confirm they scrub PII. If they want caching enabled, we need signed consent and retention TTL.
client_pmo: We can sanitize. For demo we can send template prompts with placeholders. Pricing: what is cost for a temporary burst pool for 3 hours?
anna_se: Billing options: short-term burst purchase or one-off addendum. @billing_bot can you confirm rates and approval path?
billing_bot: Rate options: ad-hoc burst = list_rate * 1.5 for duration; reserved burst credit = negotiated discount. Send estimate to finance@redwood.ai to approve.
emma_support: Immediate mitigations to try on call: 1) ask client to set batching.window_ms=8 or disable batching for warmup 2) toggle prefill=false to measure baseline 3) use prefill.tokens=6 if they want cache to help 4) pin model to quantized-low-latency variant.
liu_eng: Also suggest setting routing.pool=burst-eu for that org if available. We can temporarily bump tenant concurrency to 24 for 2h. That should suppress 429s.
anna_se: Can someone paste a quick curl they can run so we get headers? Need x-rw-ttft, x-rw-cache, x-rw-batch-window.
emma_support: Use this and paste response headers:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
  -d '{"model":"open-gpt-v2","input":"<sanitized>"}' 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Look for: x-rw-ttft:, x-rw-cache-status:, x-rw-batch-window-ms:.
ryan_oncall: Rolling a conservative infra change now: reduce batching.max_window_ms to 40 for eu-central for the next 30m while we validate. Also pushing patch that makes batch window adaptive to queue length. ETA ~10m.
priya_security: I'll DM the client template for cache consent + minimal retention wording. Keep sensitive fields out.
client_pmo: We'll run the curl in 5m with sanitized payloads. Also want written playbook for prefill/kv warmup best practices.
emma_support: I'll assemble a short playbook: warmup sequence, prefills, batching settings, pin variant, test curl + sample outputs. Will share after call.
ryan_oncall: Update: infra change deployed to eu-central. Monitoring shows batching.window_ms median down from 108->28ms, p95 TTFT improving.
anna_se: On call now: they toggled batching.window_ms=8 and set prefill.tokens=6. Observed TTFT ~140-210ms, 429s stopped. Client happy and will request a 3-hr demo burst.
billing_bot: Noted demo request: opening ticket for finance approval, estimate attached.
priya_security: Sent one-pager on cache safety and allowed data types. Client agreed to sanitized flow for demo.
emma_support: Post-call actions: 1) add curl reproducer + header parsing to KB 2) publish "POC demo burst checklist" 3) follow up with client on test logs reqs orin-44f/orin-44g 4) confirm burst billing.
anna_se: Great work team. I'll update the opportunity with notes and attach KB link. :rocket:
